title: StochasticCompositeGeneralizedSmooth.lean

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Minimize F=f+ψ over a convex measurable set Q; f is convex on E and ψ is convex on Q. A minimizer exists. Strong convexity is not required.

problem_class.label: composite
problem_class.details: The objective combines differentiable f with a possibly nonsmooth convex ψ and constraints Q, accessed through exact proximal minimization.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: At x, returns g(x,ξ) with E[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x). Oracle seeds are independent and identically distributed; the gradient map is jointly measurable.

oracle.label: proximal
oracle.details: For a>0, returns an exact minimizer over Q of ||u−z||²/(2a)+⟨v,u−z⟩+ψ(u). Gradient and proximal queries consume the same single oracle budget; neither function values nor exact gradients are supplied separately.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CompositeGeneralizedSmooth.lean: Query, proxObjective; LongTails/Setups/StochasticCompositeGeneralizedSmooth.lean: spec.admissible; LongTails/Template.lean: Setup.numOracles, executeWithTrace.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: The gradient is continuous. Whenever its norm is bounded by M along [x,y], ||∇f(x)−∇f(y)||≤(L0+L1 M)||x−y||, with L0>0 and L1≥0.

distinctive_assumptions.label: heavy_tailed_noise
distinctive_assumptions.details: Uniform central moment bound E||g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)||^α≤σ^α, with public σ≥0 and 1<α≤2. For α<2, finite variance is not required.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is a real Hilbert space with a second-countable topology and compatible Borel measurable structure; finite dimension is not required. Public parameters include L0,L1,R,Δ,x0,σ,α,ε,δ. A common minimizer x* satisfies ||x0−x*||≤R, F(x0)−F(x*)≤Δ, and ||∇f(x*)||≤G. G≥0 is hidden from the algorithm constructor but appears in its budget. No boundedness of Q is assumed.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CompositeGeneralizedSmooth.lean: Public; LongTails/Setups/StochasticCompositeGeneralizedSmooth.lean: Public, Params, spec.publicInput, spec.admissible; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: The measurable output X must satisfy F(X)−F(x*)≤ε for a minimizer x*, jointly with feasibility on the success event; ε>0.

accuracy.label: feasibility
accuracy.details: The failure event includes X∉Q; feasibility and objective accuracy must hold together.

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: P{X∉Q or F(X)−F(x*)>ε}≤δ, with 0<δ<1, under the joint algorithm and oracle randomness and a fixed total oracle-call budget.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines composite proximal optimization in a Hilbert space with gradient-dependent generalized smoothness, finite central α-moment noise, and high-probability accuracy. Its hidden bound on the smooth gradient at a composite minimizer further distinguishes it from standard smooth stochastic convex benchmarks.

descriptionHtml:
Stochastic Composite Convex Minimization

We consider minimizing F=f+ψ over a measurable convex set Q in a separable real Hilbert space E. The function f:E→R is convex and continuously differentiable, and f is (L0,L1)-smooth with L0>0 and L1≥0; ψ:E→R is measurable and convex on Q. A given feasible point x0 has bounded distance and objective gap to a minimizer x⋆. The oracle returns unbiased stochastic gradients with independent samples and bounded noise moments of order α∈(1,2], or exact proximal points. For ε>0 and δ∈(0,1), the goal is a measurable output x¯ satisfying x¯∈Q and F(x¯)−F(x⋆)≤ε with probability at least 1−δ.

Write F(x)=f(x)+ψ(x). The optimization problem is minx∈QF(x). The norm ∥⋅∥ is induced by the inner product ⟨⋅,⋅⟩ on E, which carries its Borel sigma-algebra. Let Ω be the measurable sample space. The algorithm receives E, Ω, x0, L0, L1, R, Δ, σ, α, ε, and δ; the parameter G may enter only the oracle-call budget. Their ranges are L0>0,L1≥0,R>0,Δ>0,G≥0,σ≥0,1<α≤2,ε>0,0<δ<1. Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Convexity and generalized smoothness). The function f is convex and Fréchet differentiable on E, with continuous gradient. For every x,y∈E and M∈R, ‖∇f(x+θ(y−x))‖≤Mfor all θ∈[0,1]⟹∥∇f(x)−∇f(y)∥≤(L0+L1M)∥x−y∥. The set Q is convex and Borel measurable, and ψ is measurable on E and convex on Q.

Assumption 2 (Initial bounds). The given point x0 belongs to Q. There exists x⋆∈Q such that F(x⋆)≤F(x)for every x∈Q,∥x0−x⋆∥≤R,F(x0)−F(x⋆)≤Δ,∥∇f(x⋆)∥≤G.

Assumption 3 (Exact proximal access). There is a map p:R×E×E→E such that, for every a>0 and z,v∈E, p(a,z,v)∈argminu∈Q{∥u−z∥22a+⟨v,u−z⟩+ψ(u)}. The map on R×E×E given by (a,z,v)⟼{p(a,z,v),a>0,0,a≤0 is measurable. A proximal query (a,z,v) returns p(a,z,v), with the stated minimization property for positive a.

Assumption 4 (Stochastic gradients and sampling). There is a probability measure μ on Ω and a jointly measurable map g:E×Ω→E. For every x∈E, g(x,⋅) is Bochner integrable and ∥g(x,⋅)−∇f(x)∥α is integrable under μ, with Eξ∼μ[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x),Eξ∼μ[∥g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)∥α]≤σα. The samples (ξk)k≥0 are measurable, mutually independent, and each has law μ under their joint probability law. They are independent of the algorithm’s randomness. At oracle call k, a gradient query at any x∈E returns g(x,ξk); a proximal query returns the exact point specified above.

Gradient and proximal queries share a single total call budget, with each query counting as one call. After the allotted calls, the output x¯∈E must be measurable and satisfy P{x¯∉Q or F(x¯)−F(x⋆)>ε}≤δ, where P is the joint law of the algorithm’s randomness and the oracle samples.

comparisonHtml:
On a second-countable real Hilbert space, minimize F=f+ψ over a measurable convex set Q. The convex C1 function f satisfies ∥∇f(x)−∇f(y)∥≤(L0+L1supz∈[x,y]∥∇f(z)∥)∥x−y∥ globally; ψ is measurable and convex on Q, with an exact measurable proximal oracle. IID samples from μ give a jointly measurable, integrable oracle with ∫g(x,ω)dμ=∇f(x) and ∫∥g(x,ω)−∇f(x)∥αdμ≤σα, 1<α≤2. A minimizer x⋆ satisfies ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R, F(x0)−F(x⋆)≤Δ, and ∥∇f(x⋆)∥≤G, with x0∈Q. Here L0,R,Δ,ε>0, L1,G,σ≥0, 0<δ<1. Target: P{xout∉Q or F(xout)−F(x⋆)>ε}≤δ.

import LongTails.Setups.CompositeGeneralizedSmooth
import LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex

open MeasureTheory Set

namespace LongTails.Setups.StochasticCompositeGeneralizedSmooth

open OracleTemplate

structure Public extends toComposite : CompositeGeneralizedSmooth.Public where
  [measurableE : MeasurableSpace E]
  [borelE : BorelSpace E]
  [countableE : SecondCountableTopology E]
  Ω : Type
  [measurableΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  σ : ℝ
  α : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  δ : ℝ

attribute [instance] Public.measurableE Public.borelE Public.countableE Public.measurableΩ

structure Params extends Public where
  G : ℝ

abbrev Instance (q : Public) := CompositeGeneralizedSmooth.Instance q.toComposite

abbrev Query (q : Public) := CompositeGeneralizedSmooth.Query q.toComposite

structure IsMomentOracle (q : Public) (I : Instance q) (μ : Measure q.Ω)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (g : q.E → q.Ω → q.E) : Prop where
  measurable : Measurable (Function.uncurry g)
  integrable : ∀ x, Integrable (g x) μ
  unbiased : ∀ x, ∫ ω, g x ω ∂μ = gradient I.f x
  moment_integrable : ∀ x, Integrable (fun ω => ‖g x ω - gradient I.f x‖ ^ q.α) μ
  moment : ∀ x, (∫ ω, ‖g x ω - gradient I.f x‖ ^ q.α ∂μ) ≤ q.σ ^ q.α

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params.{0}
  Public := Public.{0}
  Instance := Instance
  Query := Query
  Reply q := q.E
  Output q := q.E
  publicInput := Params.toPublic
  valid q := 0 < q.L0 ∧ 0 ≤ q.L1 ∧ 0 < q.R ∧ 0 < q.Δ ∧ 0 ≤ q.G ∧
    0 ≤ q.σ ∧ 1 < q.α ∧ q.α ≤ 2 ∧ 0 < q.ε ∧ 0 < q.δ ∧ q.δ < 1
  admissible q I O :=
    ∃ (g : q.E → q.Ω → q.E) (μ : ProbabilityMeasure q.Ω)
      (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → q.Ω)),
    StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k (ξ : ℕ → q.Ω) => ξ k)
      (μ : Measure _) (P : Measure _) ∧
    O = { Seed := fun _ => q.Ω
          law := P
          answer := fun _ (_, query) seed => match query with
            | .gradient x => g x seed
            | .prox a z v => I.prox a z v } ∧
    ConvexOn ℝ univ I.f ∧
    (∀ x, HasGradientAt I.f (I.grad x) x) ∧
    Continuous I.grad ∧
    (∀ x y M, (∀ θ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖I.grad (x + θ • (y - x))‖ ≤ M) →
      ‖I.grad x - I.grad y‖ ≤ (q.L0 + q.L1 * M) * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    Convex ℝ I.Q ∧ MeasurableSet I.Q ∧ ConvexOn ℝ I.Q I.ψ ∧ Measurable I.ψ ∧
    Measurable (fun t : ℝ × q.E × q.E =>
      if 0 < t.1 then I.prox t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2 else 0) ∧
    (∀ a, 0 < a → ∀ z v, I.prox a z v ∈ I.Q ∧
      IsMinOn (CompositeGeneralizedSmooth.proxObjective I a z v) I.Q (I.prox a z v)) ∧
    q.x0 ∈ I.Q ∧
    (∃ xstar ∈ I.Q, IsMinOn (CompositeGeneralizedSmooth.objective I) I.Q xstar ∧
      ‖q.x0 - xstar‖ ≤ q.R ∧
      CompositeGeneralizedSmooth.objective I q.x0 -
        CompositeGeneralizedSmooth.objective I xstar ≤ q.Δ ∧ ‖I.grad xstar‖ ≤ q.G) ∧
    IsMomentOracle q.toPublic I (μ : Measure _) g
  successful q I output P :=
    Measurable output ∧ ∃ xstar ∈ I.Q,
      IsMinOn (CompositeGeneralizedSmooth.objective I) I.Q xstar ∧
      (P : Measure _) {ω | output ω ∉ I.Q ∨
        q.ε < CompositeGeneralizedSmooth.objective I (output ω) -
          CompositeGeneralizedSmooth.objective I xstar} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal q.δ

end LongTails.Setups.StochasticCompositeGeneralizedSmooth
